TargetOrEvent: Engels Kombinat Kristall fuel storage facility
ImageFireEvidence: Ukraine General Staff reported explosions and subsequent fire at Kombinat Kristall; Reuters independently records only that Ukraine said it struck a fuel-storage facility in Engels. Targeted search found NASA FIRMS imagery for the 14-Nov Saratov refinery fire but no target-specific FIRMS/Sentinel/verified post-strike image for Kombinat Kristall. ASTRA's 14-Nov reporting repeats the General Staff claim rather than independently geolocating damage. Earlier January/June Kristall fire imagery is not transferable to this wave.
DecisionReason: The target and attack wave are resolved, but qualifying physical effect at this node is still not independently established. Absence of a FIRMS detection cannot exclude a hit because FIRMS has coarse resolution and cloud/view limitations. Confirming would inherit a claim; excluding would overinterpret negative remote-sensing evidence.

ImageFireEvidence: Rostov governor, Interfax, Kommersant, Vedomosti, DON24 and other Russian reporting independently establish a roughly 50-square-metre fire at one industrial enterprise after the drone attack, but none names or geolocates the enterprise. Targeted searches against the municipality's leading/systemically important enterprise lists found no source-specific link to any named city enterprise. The Novoshakhtinsk refinery's official production-site address is in Krasnosulinsky District/Kiselevskoye rural settlement, but municipal reporting has previously used generic Novoshakhtinsk 'industrial enterprise' wording for a known refinery fire, so administrative geography cannot safely identify or exclude the refinery.
DecisionReason: Physical effect is confirmed but facility identity remains unsupported. Assigning the refinery or any named Novoshakhtinsk city enterprise would be inference. Since TargetID, NodeID, sector and criticality could alter target/sector/repeat-node counts, the frozen C5 rule requires OutcomeRelevantUnresolved=TRUE.
